description: This file contains Android instrumented UI tests for the SettingsDialog component in the 'nowinandroid' project. It verifies UI states during loading and success scenarios, checking the presence, selection, and absence of specific UI elements related to settings options, links, and dynamic color preferences.

classes.name: SettingsDialogTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the behavior of the SettingsDialog UI component in different states and configurations.

methods.name: whenLoading_showsLoadingText
methods.description: Verifies that the loading text appears when the SettingsDialog is in the loading state.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_allDefaultSettingsAreDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that all default settings are displayed and correctly selected when the state is successful.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_supportsDynamicColor_usesDefaultBrand_DynamicColorOptionIsDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies that dynamic color options are displayed when supported, and the default brand is used.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_notSupportDynamicColor_DynamicColorOptionIsNotDisplayed
methods.description: Ensures that dynamic color options are hidden when not supported.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_usesAndroidBrand_DynamicColorOptionIsNotDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that dynamic color options are not displayed when the Android brand is selected.

methods.name: whenStateIsSuccess_allLinksAreDisplayed
methods.description: Verifies that privacy policy, licenses, brand guidelines, and feedback links are displayed.
